claim.quote: This analysis shows that a $10^5$ rejection power is reachable for electron/recoil discrimination.

name: MIMAC low energy electron-recoil discrimination measured with fast neutrons

summary.plain: Using neutron fields of known energy, MIMAC developed a method to reject electron background from tracks, showing that rejecting 99.999% of electron events is reachable.
summary.technical: Multivariate analysis of experimental data from monochromatic neutron fields; electron-recoil rejection power 1e5 reachable; Monte-Carlo estimate 86.49 +/- 0.17% nuclear-recoil efficiency over the full energy range.

title: MIMAC low energy electron-recoil discrimination measured with fast neutrons
why_it_matters: Background rejection of this kind is what a directional gas detector needs to separate nuclear recoils from electrons.
